_doc: Approved beat sheet (docs/02-crossover-rules.md is binding). Times t0/t1 are SECONDS relative to the sequence start. Shot authors must deliver every beat inside its window (+/- 1.5 s of slack between adjacent beats is allowed if the total is unchanged). state_in/state_out use the injury vocabulary in data/bible.json -> injury_text. World coordinates: metres, camera faces north, west = screen-left; intersection centre x=0; Gojo's traffic-light mast on the WEST corner at x=-7 (top y=6.4, arm reaching east over the intersection); lit city + sunset far west across the river; east block (Red tunnel) x=+20..+60; unfinished tower x=+80..+110; Purple channel through the eastern towers.

sequences.title: The Encounter
sequences.objective: Establish atmosphere, character and tension; plant the lit city, the trace-cursed-energy read, and Gojo's perch.
sequences.music_cue: Low string drone on D, distant restrained choir, wind; solitary taiko on the landing; near-silence for the exchange; FULL silence for the final beat before the launch.

gojo.pos: standing at ease on top of the west-corner traffic-light mast, x=-7, y=6.4

thragg.pos: high above the district, descending, off-screen

state_in.env: pristine evacuated district at storm-dark dusk; lit city across the river to the west

beats.beat: Aerial establishing shot descending through the storm deck: the dark evacuated district below, the river and the LIT city beyond it to the west under a smouldering sunset. Wind through shattered windows, dust across the empty intersection, distant thunder.
beats.notes: EWS crane-down; no characters yet (or Thragg a tiny falling speck in the last second).

beats.beat: Thragg drops vertically, no wasted motion, and lands in the centre of the intersection (x=0): pavement cracks radially, dust ring rolls out, storefront glass bursts outward. Crimson cape settles.
beats.notes: heavy landing signature (land_heavy + glass_shatter).

beats.beat: He rises slowly; one economical turn of the head surveying the street with cold contempt; his gaze settles WEST on the lights across the river.
beats.notes: posture, breathing, stillness = power.

beats.beat: Cut to Gojo standing casually atop the bent west-corner mast, hands in pockets, the lit city and sunset directly behind him; faint amused smile.
beats.notes: Gojo screen-left, Thragg screen-right for the whole film.

beats.beat: Six Eyes read: through the blindfold Gojo sees only a faint civilian-level haze of cursed energy wrapped around a body of absurd density. One eyebrow lifts. He hooks the blindfold up a finger's width - one brilliant blue eye - then lets it drop back.
beats.notes: plants R1 (trace CE) and R5.

beats.beat: THRAGG: "You stand in my way." (literal - Gojo stands between him and the lights). GOJO: "You should've picked an easier planet."

dialogue.speaker: Gojo
dialogue.line: You should've picked an easier planet.

beats.beat: Silence. Slow push-in on both, intercut; wind only.
beats.notes: music event: silence.

beats.beat: Thragg launches without warning: one compressed anticipation frame, the ground tears behind him, a sonic crack destroys the silence.
beats.notes: transition into Seq 2 on the acceleration.

gojo.pos: on the west mast arm, x=-6, y=6.2

state_out.env: landing crater at x=0 with radial cracks; storefront glass burst

sequences.title: The First Impact
sequences.objective: Demonstrate Thragg's terrifying physical power and introduce Infinity as deceleration, not a wall; Thragg investigates.
sequences.music_cue: 96 BPM low percussion and electronic pulse; low brass stabs placed BETWEEN blows; thin under each infinity_stop so the ring reads.

gojo.pos: on the west mast arm, x=-6, y=6.2

beats.beat: E1: Thragg crosses the gap in an instant and throws a precise straight right at Gojo's head. At the last instant the fist decelerates and stops short: air compresses into a disc, grit and asphalt shards HANG in the gap. Gojo does not move; looks at the fist, then at Thragg. GOJO: "That's close. For you."
beats.intent: end it with one blow to the head
beats.read: Gojo does not react at all - Infinity is automatic
beats.outcome: the fist slows without end and never arrives; the side lobes of the shock blow out windows behind Gojo
beats.learned: his knuckles felt nothing: it is not a wall, his fist is SLOWING
beats.notes: KEY VISUAL PLANT: shards hanging in the gap (rhymes with Seq 7).

beats.beat: E2: combination at three heights - hook to the temple, knee to the ribs, low kick at the knee - then a sweep that shears the mast arm out from under Gojo. Every blow stalls at the same distance; Gojo tilts his head a few degrees, shifts his weight; when the arm falls away he simply keeps standing on nothing.
beats.intent: find a gap: different targets, angles, trajectories
beats.read: Gojo is comfortable, not defending
beats.outcome: each strike decelerates and hangs; the mast arm crashes down; Gojo hovers
beats.learned: angle and target do not matter; he needs no footing
beats.notes: vary angles; never repeat the blocked-punch animation.

beats.beat: E3: feint high, the real strike from the side at the solar plexus, then an elevation change into a downward hammer-fist from above. Gojo does not react to the feint at all. Close-ups of Thragg's eyes: confusion turning to analytical focus.
beats.intent: exploit an opening / test whether it is a reflex
beats.read: no reaction to the feint
beats.learned: "He isn't defending. Something is." The block is not a reflex.

beats.beat: E4: Thragg tears up a slab of street and hurls it; it decelerates, hangs before Gojo's chest, then drops.
beats.intent: test mass
beats.read: Gojo watches it come

beats.beat: E5: Thragg abruptly retreats ~300 m east over the rooftops, arcs around, and returns at maximum speed from a different direction (high, from behind Gojo's right). Gojo calmly turns to face him before he arrives. The strike stops in the same place with the same hanging shards; the sonic boom flattens lamp posts around them while Gojo's collar does not stir.
beats.intent: test whether speed/momentum or attention matters
beats.read: Gojo turns calmly - he is not timing anything
beats.learned: it is a property of the space around him, not his attention; speed and mass do not matter
beats.notes: motivated screen-direction change: show the arc so the audience tracks him.

beats.beat: Thragg hovers ~30 m above the ruined street (east side), studying Gojo with growing hostility; Gojo stands on air at the west corner, hands back in pockets.
beats.notes: transition: conventional force is not enough.

gojo.pos: standing on air where the mast arm was, west corner, x=-6, y=6

thragg.pos: hovering 30 m up over the east side of the intersection, x=+12, y=30

state_out.env: mast arm sheared and fallen; torn-up street slab; ring of blown-out windows; lamp posts flattened

sequences.title: The Sorcerer Takes Control
sequences.objective: Gojo's combat intelligence, Limitless, Blue, hand-to-hand, Red; contact is one-way; Thragg commits.
sequences.music_cue: 112 BPM; Gojo's rising-fifth brass motif enters; glassy synth arpeggio; hit on the Red release; held beat under 'Now we're fighting'.

gojo.pos: standing on air at the west corner, x=-6, y=6

beats.beat: Gojo raises one hand, two fingers extended; the scenery bends faintly.

E1: a Blue forms BESIDE Thragg (not on him). Small fragments accelerate first, then cars, lamp posts and concrete slabs, all streaming in straight lines toward the point. Thragg fights the pull with a tangential burn like a ship escaping orbit, adjusting his flight path while debris tears past and cuts his sightline.
beats.intent: Gojo: can convergence pin a flyer?
beats.read: Thragg feels a pull with no source and burns against it
beats.outcome: he holds, but is dragged and blinded by the debris stream
beats.learned: Gojo: he can fight a moderate pull - use the blindness instead. Thragg: Gojo can MOVE him

beats.beat: E2: Gojo closes the distance with a Blue self-pull and delivers precise hand-to-hand: palm to the floating ribs, an elbow that turns Thragg's jaw, then he catches Thragg's wrist (chosen contact) and redirects his momentum down into the Blue's wreckage, releasing the Blue so the heap collapses on top of him.
beats.intent: Gojo: test the body, constrain him with the environment
beats.read: Thragg tries to grab back - his hand stalls in Infinity
beats.outcome: Thragg is buried under compacted cars and steel; Gojo's blows land but do not hurt much
beats.learned: Thragg: HE can touch ME; I cannot touch him. Gojo: this is the hardest body he has ever hit

beats.beat: E3: Thragg bursts out of the heap, absorbing it all, and counters with a zero-wind-up inside hook. The Six Eyes give Gojo no intent to read; his Toji-trained instinct evades anyway - a pivot on the ball of his foot, the fist passing an inch from his jaw.
beats.intent: Thragg: punish the close range
beats.read: Gojo reads it late (body outclasses its cursed energy)
beats.outcome: Gojo evades even though Infinity would likely have held
beats.learned: Thragg: "He dodged. Why dodge, if nothing touches him?"

beats.beat: E4: out of the pivot, Red at close range from Gojo's fingertip: a crimson directional pressure wave throws Thragg EAST through three layers of concrete facades; his cape is torn to shreds.
beats.intent: Gojo: punish the commitment
beats.read: Thragg is mid-strike, no guard
beats.learned: Gojo: Red moves him but doesn't break him

beats.beat: Wide shot of the destructive path: a straight tunnel through three east-side facades, floors slumping, dust pouring out.
beats.notes: wide impact shot.

beats.beat: Thragg emerges from the rubble ~60 m east: uniform torn at the right shoulder and chest, split lip, cape in rags. Contempt gives way to focused aggression. He wipes blood from his mouth and smiles faintly. THRAGG: "Now we're fighting."

Gojo's expression becomes slightly more serious. He hooks the blindfold down to his neck - his white hair falls loose - and looks at Thragg with uncovered blue eyes (he needs his real eyes to read a body that leaks no intent).
beats.notes: transition: Thragg abandons testing.

gojo.pos: standing on the street, west of centre, x=-4, y=0

thragg.pos: standing in the rubble of the third facade, x=+60, y=0

state_out.env: Blue debris heap mid-street; Red tunnel through three east-side facades

sequences.title: Viltrumite Fury
sequences.objective: Thragg's extended physical showcase AND investigation; door one (Infinity off as bait); Gojo's smile fades.
sequences.music_cue: 140 BPM taiko/toms, driving ostinato, both motifs in counterpoint; peak at the tower crash; music drops for the 'smile fades' close-up.

beats.beat: E1: Thragg explodes out of the rubble into an aerial assault - from above, below, both flanks, feints and violent direction changes; grab attempts at Gojo's collar and throat stall short, fingers hanging. Gojo blocks nothing, evades only what he reads late, and counters with short Blues that yank Thragg off his line - but Thragg starts moving BEFORE each Blue point forms, reading Gojo's hand, and never lingers inside Gojo's reach (hit-and-run).
beats.intent: Thragg: pressure + provoke counters while never staying in reach
beats.read: Gojo: he is reading my hands
beats.learned: Thragg: break off whenever the hand moves. Gojo: he won't stay still long enough for a point-blank Red

beats.beat: E2 (slow-hand test): Thragg drifts in SLOWLY with an open hand toward Gojo's collar. It stalls exactly the same way. Gojo raises an eyebrow, amused.
beats.intent: is it keyed to speed?
beats.read: Gojo lets him try
beats.learned: "It judges what I am, not how fast I move."

beats.beat: E3 (deny the eyes): Thragg noticed the blindfold come off after the late dodge - the eyes matter. He smashes the facades on both sides into dust and punches the street into a debris geyser. In the murk Gojo still tracks the faint haze but loses the body read; a strike from inside the dust stalls an inch from his ear - he never saw it. Gojo answers with a Blue overhead that vacuums the dust and debris into a dense churning ball, clearing the air, and flings it into Thragg's path; Thragg punches straight through it.
beats.intent: blind the uncovered eyes
beats.read: Gojo: the dust is aimed at my eyes
beats.outcome: Gojo has to spend a Blue to see again

beats.beat: E4 (force at scale): a whole-body haymaker into the rooftop BESIDE Gojo - testing whether the shockwave itself can reach him. The shockwave rolls across the skyline, windows burst for blocks, and the storm deck overhead tears open. Gojo's collar does not flutter; the wave parts around him.
beats.intent: test shockwave transmission
beats.read: Gojo watches the wave fold around him
beats.learned: even air at that force is held
beats.notes: THE TORN CLOUD DECK is the on-screen cause of Seq 7's light shafts. Massive tier.

beats.beat: E5: Gojo's intent - Thragg's hit-and-run means he can't fix him for a point-blank Red; take him somewhere he can't dodge sideways. Gojo Blue-pulls himself into the unfinished tower; tracking shot as Thragg follows through its flank: concrete beams snap, steel supports buckle, curtain-wall glass bursts outward.
beats.notes: tracking shot through the tower.

beats.beat: E6 DOOR ONE: on a gutted floor Gojo deliberately switches Infinity OFF (bait - the refraction ripple dies; a falling chip of concrete taps his sleeve). Thragg commits his whole body and stays: his hand seizes Gojo's left shoulder - the thumb crushes the collarbone, first pain on Gojo's face - while his other hand drives his signature spear-hand at the heart. Gojo re-raises Infinity at high output: space swells, the grip is pried open finger by finger and the spear-hand decelerates centimetres from his chest. Point-blank Red: the explosion guts three floors and throws BOTH out into open sky.
beats.intent: Gojo: fix Thragg at zero distance for a point-blank Red. Thragg: the opening he has waited for
beats.read: Thragg sees the shimmer vanish and commits
beats.outcome: Thragg: two cracked ribs, chest burn. Gojo: broken collarbone, jacket torn
beats.learned: Thragg: the barrier can be OFF
beats.notes: the brief's 'Thragg attempts to seize Gojo... Gojo slips out with spatial abilities and counters with Red'.

beats.beat: Open sky: Thragg stabilises first. Gojo, tumbling, re-sets the collarbone with RCT - a soft warm shimmer, the shoulder shifting back into place. Thragg WATCHES the bone heal. THRAGG: "So. It is a choice."
beats.learned: Thragg: the barrier is a choice; he heals - so the damage must be total

beats.beat: Thragg attacks again. Close-up: for the first time Gojo's relaxed smile fades - Thragg is not merely powerful, he is learning.
beats.notes: transition: the next escalation must be decisive.

gojo.pos: open sky NE of the tower, ~150 m up, x=+120, y=150

state_out.env: facades dust-shattered; skyline windows blown; cloud deck torn open overhead; unfinished tower gutted on three floors, crane down

sequences.title: Hollow Purple
sequences.objective: First major cinematic peak: Hollow Purple with full identity; the lit city constrains Gojo; Thragg evades and counters but pays.
sequences.music_cue: Total drop to a low rumble as Gojo raises his hands; choir and brass enter in layers through the charge; full orchestra crest on the release frame; sustained strings over the aftermath.

beats.beat: Gojo slips the renewed attack with a Blue self-pull upward. The combat pauses above the shattered skyline: Thragg hovers amid drifting debris, breathing heavily, a hand pressed to his cracked ribs - and deliberately drifts so that the lit city across the river sits directly behind him.
beats.intent: Thragg: use the lights as a shield (hostage logic)

beats.beat: Gojo's read: any flat shot that misses goes into the city. He rises and relocates up and to the WEST of Thragg to set a downward line into the empty eastern district - costing a beat.
beats.intent: protect the city
beats.read: Thragg notes he protects the lights

beats.beat: The soundtrack falls away. Gojo raises both hands: Blue at the left hand pulls particles inward (light ones first); Red at the right throws violent repulsion and jitters. The two converge with crackling tension arcs; loose debris vibrates; light bends; the sky darkens around the focal point. Gojo's face is perfectly still - precise control.
beats.notes: show the separate energies first; Purple takes time to charge (ch 233).

beats.beat: Thragg recognises the first time Gojo has needed TIME, and launches straight down the line to interrupt before it can form.
beats.intent: deny the charge
beats.read: Gojo: the fastest line is also the most predictable

beats.beat: Release. Camera transitions from Gojo's face along the trajectory. Thragg's last-instant corkscrew roll takes him out of the core (the beat Gojo lost relocating) - but the sphere's shell clips his trailing LEFT FOREARM, which is torn away at mid-forearm, and the displacement wake flays his left flank and tears his left ear. Still mid-arc, he swings a counter at Gojo's flank that stalls in Infinity before the wake throws him away.
beats.intent: Thragg: evade and counter through raw speed
beats.outcome: core misses; forearm lost; flank flayed
beats.learned: Gojo: anything I aim, this body can dodge
beats.notes: CREATIVE margin per R7; no claim about the core vs Viltrumite flesh.

beats.beat: Purple carries on and carves a clean channel through four eastern towers and a trench down the street - wide shot; towers sheared, tops sliding, violet afterglow on the cut edges.
beats.notes: devastates a large section of the skyline - a wall of imaginary mass, not a beam.

beats.beat: As the light fades: shattered buildings, dust and smoke spreading through the sky. Thragg emerges one-armed, bleeding heavily, listing in flight (torn ear) - no longer amused. Gojo lowers his hands, breathing deliberately, eyes bloodshot; he presses two fingers to his temple - a faint RCT shimmer as he refreshes his brain - and his eyes clear.
beats.notes: plants RCT-on-the-brain for Seq 7. Transition: Thragg prepares to end it before another decisive technique.

gojo.pos: hovering ~200 m up, west of the Purple channel, x=-20, y=200

thragg.pos: hovering, listing, east of the channel, x=+70, y=140

state_out.env: Purple channel through four eastern towers + street trench; smoke columns; dust plume drifting west

sequences.title: The Domain
sequences.objective: Unlimited Void as the supernatural climax - mechanism shown, not a magic button; the touch exemption nearly saves Thragg; Gojo's gamble begins.
sequences.music_cue: Silence at the hand sign; then high crystalline clusters, sub drone and granular information ticks; heartbeat under Thragg's close-ups; no rhythm inside the domain; reversed-shatter as it ends.

beats.beat: Thragg's final high-speed assault: he climbs into the Purple's dust plume (denying Gojo the body-read), then breaks WEST out of it at maximum speed, low across the intersection toward the river and the lit city - making Gojo choose between the people and holding back.
beats.intent: leverage: hostage logic + deny time for another Purple
beats.read: Gojo: the faint haze tells him where; the geometry tells him why

beats.beat: Split-second decision: Gojo teleports to the west corner (his Seq 1 perch) directly into Thragg's path. The environment falls silent. One hand rises: middle finger crossed over the index. GOJO: "Domain Expansion. Unlimited Void." (Pre-set: about two seconds - Shoko's ~1 s for Sukuna, doubled.)
beats.notes: logged deviation: one-hand sign (canon) vs brief 'hands together'.

beats.beat: Transition: a black sphere swallows the frame from the hand sign outward, edged with a thin line of cold blue light; inside - a boundless void of impossible depth, receding rings, a slow galactic spiral, luminous information streaming outward.
beats.notes: beautiful, alien, unsettling - not an arena.

beats.beat: Thragg's charge is interrupted as the sure-hit takes hold: frozen mid-lunge, visibly huge and visibly helpless. Tight close-ups: his pupils flooding with light streaks, micro-expressions frozen half-formed; every speck of dust carrying its whole history; Gojo's focused face.
beats.notes: perception time (~2 s real shown as ~20 s).

beats.beat: Gojo's close-range sequence: a Blue pins Thragg and turns his torso to expose the flayed left flank; three single-frame snapping contacts (each touch strobes Thragg's pupils - the exemption); then Gojo drives a spear-hand into the flayed ribs toward the heart. The contact lasts - Thragg is EXEMPT for its duration: his eyes focus, lucid and murderous, and his body twists the heart off the line - ribs break, the left lung ruptures, the heart is missed. His right hand rises toward Gojo's throat and stalls in Infinity. Gojo withdraws; the flood slams back in.
beats.intent: Gojo: kill while he is frozen (heart-blow pattern)
beats.read: contact wakes him
beats.learned: Gojo: touching him wakes him; the Six Eyes cannot read his vitals
beats.notes: heart-slip is a CREATIVE trained reflex (T1-34 shows it is physically possible).

beats.beat: The uninterrupted flood: Thragg bleeds from the nose, ears and tear ducts; his pupils go unequal and blank; a heartbeat thuds. Gojo watches, breathing hard: he cannot tell if this is killing him. He decides: finish by hand outside.
Brief return to the ruined city: a perfect black dome sits silently over the west corner of the intersection, wind tugging dust around it; then it thins and dissolves.
beats.notes: the domain's effect reaches its resolution.

beats.beat: Inside, the void dissolves from its edges - the domain ends; the consequences of the exchange are about to be revealed.
beats.notes: transition into Seq 7.

gojo.pos: at the west corner, ~3 m up, x=-7, y=3 (about to drop)

thragg.pos: mid-lunge ~8 m east of Gojo, x=+1, y=2 (about to drop)

state_out.env: no new damage from the domain itself

sequences.title: The Final Exchange
sequences.objective: The most memorable 30 s: burnout, Gojo's gamble, Thragg's will, the race between Thragg's fist and Gojo's repair; one slow motion; decisive impact into silence.
sequences.music_cue: Isolated piano-like tones over the dust; rebuilds into a 150 BPM ostinato with both motifs colliding for the final assault; the slow motion stretches one chord; HARD CUT TO SILENCE on the impact frame; silence holds through the wide silhouette.

state_in.env: intersection west corner; torn cloud deck

sequences.real_time_map: screen 0-4 s = real 0-1 s (overlapping angles); 4-10 = real 1-5 (near real time); 10-16 = real 5.0-6.0 (fast alternating overlapping cuts); 16-23 = real 6.0-6.4 (THE slow motion); 23-30 = real time.

beats.beat: The ruined city reappears: dust drifting through shafts of evening light falling through the torn cloud deck. Burnout: Gojo - who has floated effortlessly all film - drops to the asphalt and his shoes skid. Thragg drops to one knee ~8 m east: one-armed, flank open, frothy blood at the mouth, bleeding from nose, ears and tear ducts, pupils unequal, a tremor in his hand.

Gojo's gamble ('Shibuya mode'): he does not spend the brain-damaging repair; he walks toward Thragg with purpose to finish him by hand. Thragg struggles to regain control - fingers clawing the asphalt, head jerking as after-images flood back, eyes failing to focus.
beats.intent: Gojo: cheap physical finish on a frozen target
beats.read: Thragg is lagging
beats.notes: Thragg's function is CREATIVE: will, not recovery.

beats.beat: Thragg's lagging lunge - misjudged by a hand's breadth - smashes the asphalt beside Gojo; a shard of asphalt slices Gojo's cheek. Blood. (In Seq 2 the same shards hung in the air.) Thragg SEES the blood: the barrier is off. Gojo instantly begins the brain repair - a muscle jumps at his temple, blood wells in one nostril.
beats.intent: Thragg: strike before the freeze returns
beats.read: Thragg: the shard cut him

beats.beat: Thragg's second strike, at the head (a man who heals must be destroyed whole). Gojo parries with his cursed-energy-reinforced left forearm; Thragg's hand closes on it and tears it off at the elbow. Gojo cannot heal the arm while repairing his technique.
beats.intent: Thragg: destroy the head
beats.read: Gojo: parry to buy the last fraction of a second
beats.outcome: Gojo loses the forearm; the strike's line is knocked wide

beats.beat: THE ONLY SLOW MOTION: Thragg's fist driving forward at Gojo's eye from arm's length, his whole body committed, no guard. Gojo's eyes narrowing. The repair completes - the nosebleed spurts - and space distorts again: concrete fragments kicked up by Thragg's charge stop in mid-air; the fist decelerates without end, 1 cm from Gojo's eye (mirroring Seq 2). The precise moment their strategies intersect: Gojo's two remaining fingers slide into the open left flank.
beats.notes: slow_motion = true for exactly this beat.

beats.beat: Full speed: Red, inside the chest. A massive crimson shockwave expands across the intersection; cars, lamp posts and the crater rim are thrown outward; the toppled mast spins away. The soundtrack drops out at the moment of impact.
beats.notes: massive tier; music event: silence at the contact frame.

beats.beat: Hold a wide silhouette through the dust: one figure standing at the west corner; one shape down in the new crater beneath the toppled mast. Silence, a faint high ring.
beats.notes: transition: the dust begins to settle.

gojo.pos: standing at the west corner, x=-6, y=0

thragg.pos: on his back in the crater beneath the toppled mast, x=-2, y=0

state_out.env: large crater at the west corner; traffic-light mast toppled

sequences.title: The Verdict
sequences.objective: Reveal the winner decisively through aftermath, condition and composition; end on an image of Gojo's personality; cut to black at exactly 04:00.
sequences.music_cue: Restrained final statement: solo low brass + strings, Gojo's rising fifth resolved, no percussion; last note ends on the cut.

beats.beat: The dust clears. Thragg lies in the crater beneath the toppled traffic-light mast - Gojo's perch from Seq 1 - his chest open and smoking. One last rise of the chest, then stillness. The defeat is unmistakable.

Slow push-in on Gojo standing amid the ruins, left arm ending at the elbow, the stump sealed and slowly beginning to regrow; he wipes his nose with the back of his remaining hand. Behind him, across the river, the lit city is untouched. The soundtrack returns with a restrained final statement. One-handed, he hooks the blindfold back up over his eyes - his hair springs up into its spikes - and a faint, tired smile returns. GOJO (quiet): "Told you."
Final image: Gojo blindfolded, silhouetted against the lit city and the last of the sunset. Cut to black at exactly 04:00:00.
beats.notes: no title card, no post-credit, no lingering footage.

state_out.env: dust settling; lit western city untouched
